stage_b_config_issues:
Reproduced: alint validate-config loads all 53 rules of docs/design/v0.12/corpus/cloudflare-workers-sdk.alint.yml, and `alint check` on the clone exits 0. I reproduced the family A fire tests on my own scratch copy:
- wsdk-10: ^ range, `||` range and >= all fire.
- wsdk-11: ^ range, hyphen range and an optionalDependencies ~ range all fire; a range in a private package passes.
- wsdk-05: deleting deps.ts, renaming the export, adding an external dep without deps.ts, and adding a catalog: dep without deps.ts all fire.
- wsdk-54: ^, a partial version, yarn@ and removing the field all fire.
- wsdk-73: an unknown workspace: name fires in both dependencies and devDependencies.

wsdk-catalog-entries-pinned (wsdk-10) matches the exception by value, as Stage A noted, and I reproduced the miss. Setting a catalog entry (zod) to the workers-types range "^5.20261112.1" does NOT fire. A companion rule closes the hole: it fires on that mutation and passes on the clone.
```
kind: yaml_path_absent
paths: ["pnpm-workspace.yaml"]
path: "$[?count($.catalog[?@ == $.catalog['@cloudflare/workers-types']]) > 1 && !match($.catalog['@cloudflare/workers-types'], '[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?([+][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?')]"
```

wsdk-deps-ts-exports-external-dependencies (wsdk-05) fires where the script does not. It matches every packages/*/scripts/deps.ts, but validate-package-dependencies.ts checks only public packages and returns early when a package has no non-workspace dependencies (:181). Reproduced on scratch: a private package whose deps.ts lacks the export fires (05e), and so does a public package with no external deps whose deps.ts lacks it (05f). The script passes both. Neither case exists at the pin, so the unit stays A, but the rule over-reaches.

wsdk-catalog-refs-resolve (wsdk-74):
- Its comment says the over-capture 'can only hide a miss, never fire'. That is false in the other direction. The source regex keeps only quoted values that start with an optional ^ or ~ and then a digit. An unquoted catalog value (`zod: 4.6.6`) or a ">=" range drops that key from the source set, so every manifest using catalog: for it false-fires. Reproduced: six or more manifests fired on scratch.
- It also does not cover the catalog:default reference in pnpm-workspace.yaml's own overrides block ("@types/node>undici-types": "catalog:default").

wsdk-workspace-refs-resolve and wsdk-catalog-refs-resolve (wsdk-73/74) hard-code the workspace member globs instead of reading them from pnpm-workspace.yaml `packages:`. If a member glob is added there, a workspace: ref to a package in the new dir false-fires until the rule is updated. Low impact.

wsdk-51 evidence and mechanism are incomplete. computeTiers' cycle check runs on every PR, not only at release: publish-packages.test.ts:260-306 calls computeTiers(findPublishablePackages()) on the real workspace, and test-and-check.yml:206 runs it. Add the test as evidence; the mechanism is test as well as script.

wsdk-55/56, Stage A's 'unverified' note:
- c3-e2e.yml:107-110 says in a comment that pnpm 11 bails 'with ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE at the monorepo root'. That is repository evidence that root engines.pnpm is enforced, which supports wsdk-55.
- For wsdk-56, only the Node 22.23.4 default leg gates every PR. The 24.18.0 and 25 legs in test-and-check-other-node.yml are expected_to_fail and run only on changeset-release/main or with the ci:test-all-node-versions label, so the summary overstates the per-PR versions. Whether pnpm enforces root engines.node is still unverified.

wsdk-42 lumps four pnpm behaviors (frozen lockfile, minimumReleaseAge, blockExoticSubdeps, allowBuilds) into one D unit, which strains R1. Counts do not move because all of them are D. I did not verify how each behaves under --frozen-lockfile.

Possible missed unit, NOT counted because unverified: the override "@types/node": "$@types/node" in pnpm-workspace.yaml's overrides block must name a direct dependency of the root package.json, or pnpm cannot resolve the override. I did not confirm that pnpm checks this under --frozen-lockfile. If it does, it is a dep-version reference unit, C through regex extraction (JSONPath cannot select keys).

wsdk-75 scope: the same Dependabot/pnpm release-age convention also covers the exclude lists. Dependabot's cooldown.exclude {workerd, @cloudflare/workers-types} (dependabot.yml:42-45) is a subset of pnpm's minimumReleaseAgeExclude (pnpm-workspace.yaml:41-52, which includes @cloudflare/* and workerd). It holds at the pin. This is the same behavior under R1, so no new unit.

wsdk-65 stays C. markdown_required_headings matches the complete heading sequence against a template, and its `*` wildcard matches any headings, so it cannot forbid levels 1 to 3 in a fence-aware way.
stage_b_summary:
Stage A's record is largely sound. The config loads all 53 rules, `alint check` on the clone exits 0, and every family A fire test reproduces on my own scratch copy: wsdk-05, wsdk-10, wsdk-11, wsdk-54 and wsdk-73. The C unit wsdk-12 also fires on a date edit and a workerd bump.

**Precision problems found:**
- wsdk-10: the by-value exception misses a catalog entry that shares the workers-types range. A verified count() companion rule closes it.
- wsdk-05: the deps.ts export rule fires on private packages and on packages with no external deps, which the script does not check.
- wsdk-74: the catalog-refs rule false-fires when a catalog value is unquoted or a >= range, contrary to its comment.

**Missed units: 6, all family other.**
- Three CI tests that assert committed repo state are A by their logic (R7, forem precedent), each verified to fire and to pass on the clone:
  - environment.ts @default values are not escaped;
  - the releasable-set snapshot in validate-changesets.test.ts;
  - the public/private status of named packages.
- B-kernel: the real-workspace publish-tier snapshot and ordering test.
- Two B-adapter units split out of D tool runs:
  - oxfmt sortPackageJson key order (the i18n-tasks normalize precedent);
  - the custom oxlint rule requiring a reason on disable directives. A regex probe fails R4 at the pin.

**Removed:** wsdk-62. zizmor is not run in CI, and its env-not-inline rule is violated at the pin.

**Reclassified:**
- wsdk-75 moves from dep-version to other (a cooldown setting, not a version).
- wsdk-17's assertion family moves from reference to set.

**Revised counts:** A 32, B-config 1, B-adapter 9, B-kernel 1, C 5, D 35.
- coverage_today 32/48 (67%), with tuning 37/48 (77%), gap 11/48 (23%).
- dep-version: A 4, B-adapter 3, C 2, D 3.
- toolchain-pin is unchanged (A 1, B-adapter 2, D 3).
- No slice-family (equality, unique-key, cardinality) B-config units, so the before/after-slice figures do not move.

No missed locale, dep-version or toolchain-pin units survived verification. The only candidate, the `$@types/node` override reference, is reported unverified and not counted. The scratch directory <scratch>/cloudflare-workers-sdk-b has been removed. The clone and the Stage A config were not modified.

changes.detail: Added Stage B's companion yaml_path_absent rule (count() of catalog entries equal to the @cloudflare/workers-types value > 1 while that value is not exact). It closes the by-value exception hole in wsdk-catalog-entries-pinned, whose comment now points to it. Passes on the clone. On a scratch copy, setting zod to "^5.20261112.1" fired it, and the main rule did not fire on that change. With workers-types and zod both set to the exact "5.20261112.1", it passed. With workerd set to "^1.20261112.1", the main rule fired.

Source regex rewritten to read every two-space-indented mapping key whatever its value: '(?m)^  ["'']?([^"''\s:#-][^"''\s:]*)["'']?[ \t]*:'. The earlier value-gated regex dropped a catalog key whose value was unquoted or a >= range. I reproduced Stage B's false fire on scratch: the old rule gave 11 errors with zod: 4.6.6 unquoted. The new rule passes on both the unquoted and the >= mutation. pnpm-workspace.yaml was added to the target glob, and the target regex now also reads an overrides selector's last segment ("@types/node>undici-types": "catalog:default" gives undici-types). The comment was corrected: over-capture comes from allowBuilds, overrides, peerDependencyRules and patchedDependencies, and it can only hide a miss. C: passes on the clone. It fired on an override renamed to undici-typez and on wrangler's esbuild renamed to esbuildz: catalog:default.

Over-reach reproduced: a private package's deps.ts without the export fires here, but the script skips it. No fix is possible. The condition is in package.json and the requirement is in deps.ts, and nested rules have no disjunction. when_iter has no content predicates. A cross_file set relation has no value common to both files. I probed a for_each_dir nested file_content_matches with a scope_filter include_manifest_paths source of "{path}/package.json" plus a derive_target: the source is not templated, and the result was an analysis failure ('scope manifest is missing'). I documented the limitation at the rule. The rule is unchanged and still passes on the clone. Unit stays A, since neither over-reach case exists at the pin.

Comment added: the member globs are copied by hand from pnpm-workspace.yaml packages:, because a cross_file glob cannot be read from a file. A newly added member glob would make the rule false-fire until the copied globs are updated. This was not reproduced (a hypothetical future change), so the rule is unchanged.

file_content_forbidden '@default[^\S\n]+`' on packages/workers-utils/src/config/environment.ts. That file exists, and configSchema.test.ts:6-17 tests /@default\s+`/ per line. test:ci runs it through test-and-check.yml:219. Passes on the clone. On scratch, backticking the first @default (line 233) fired it. Changing '@defaults to 22' to '@defaultsy `22`' did not fire, which matches the JS regex.

cross_file set_equals. Source: packages/*/package.json with wsdk-19's selector, matching findPackages() at validate-changesets.ts:109-131. Target: validate-changesets.test.ts with the regex (?m)^\t{4}"([^"]+)",$. All 34 matches are in the list at lines 25-58. Passes on the clone. On scratch it fired on each of: a new public packages/new-public, deleting the solarflare-theme line, a deploy script added to private remote-bindings, and miniflare made private.

Passes on the clone. On scratch, wrangler private and miniflare private each fired it. Stage B flags this unit as borderline instance-level.
